notice: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PLAN. Fictional patient. Not a clinical template and not reviewed by a clinician.

diagnoses.name: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
diagnoses.documented_note: Admitted with fluid overload. Discharge weight 82 kg (180.8 lb). Medicines adjusted; diuretic dose set for home.

items.title: Weigh yourself every morning
items.original: Weigh yourself every morning after you urinate and before you eat breakfast. Write your weight down every day.
items.plain: Every morning, weigh yourself after you pee and before you eat breakfast. Write the number down each day.

facts.statement: Weigh every morning after urinating and before breakfast; write it down.

items.title: Call for weight gain
items.original: Call the heart failure clinic if you gain more than 2 pounds in one day or more than 5 pounds in one week, or if your legs or belly are more swollen.
items.plain: Call the heart failure clinic if your weight goes up more than 2 pounds in one day, or more than 5 pounds in one week. Also call if your legs or belly get more swollen.

facts.statement: Call if weight goes up more than 2 pounds in a day or 5 pounds in a week.

misconceptions.pattern: \b(wait|waiting|until|till|hold off|put off|watch it|keep an eye on it)\b[^.]*\b(appointment|visit|next week|few days|couple of days|couple days|a while|tomorrow)\b
misconceptions.message: Your instructions say to call the clinic when your weight goes up this much, rather than waiting for your next visit.
Your instructions do not say to change your water pill dose on your own. Call the heart failure clinic; they will tell you what to do.

items.title: Furosemide 40 mg tablet
items.original: Furosemide 40 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth once a day in the morning.
items.plain: Furosemide is a water pill. It helps your body get rid of extra fluid. Take one 40 mg pill once a day, in the morning.

task.label: Take furosemide as written on your medicine label

facts.statement: Take 40 mg once a day in the morning.

items.title: Sacubitril/valsartan 24 mg/26 mg tablet
items.original: Sacubitril/valsartan 24 mg/26 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth twice a day.
items.plain: Sacubitril/valsartan helps your heart pump better. Take one 24 mg/26 mg pill two times a day.

task.label: Take sacubitril/valsartan as written on your medicine label

facts.statement: Take one 24 mg/26 mg tablet twice a day.

items.title: Carvedilol 6.25 mg tablet
items.original: Carvedilol 6.25 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth twice a day with food.
items.plain: Carvedilol helps your heart over time. Take one 6.25 mg pill two times a day, with food.

task.label: Take carvedilol as written on your medicine label

facts.statement: Take 6.25 mg twice a day with food.

items.title: Salt and fluid limits
items.original: Limit sodium (salt) to 2,000 mg a day. Limit all fluids to 2 liters (about 8 cups) a day.
items.plain: Eat no more than 2,000 mg of sodium (salt) a day. Drink no more than 2 liters of fluid a day. That is about 8 cups.

facts.statement: No more than 2,000 mg of sodium a day.
No more than 2 liters (about 8 cups) of fluid a day.

items.title: Emergency warning signs
items.original: Call 911 if you have severe shortness of breath, chest pain, fainting, or you cannot catch your breath while resting.
items.plain: Call 911 if you are very short of breath, have chest pain, faint, or cannot catch your breath even when resting.

facts.statement: Call 911 for severe breathlessness, chest pain or fainting.

misconceptions.message: Your instructions say to call 911 for these signs rather than getting yourself to the hospital.

misconceptions.pattern: \b(wait|waiting) (and see|to see|it out|a (bit|while|day))\b|\bsee if it (passes|goes away|gets better|stops)\b|\b(sleep it off|rest and see|lie down and see)\b|\bwait\b[^.]{0,30}\b(pass|passes|goes away|better|over)\b
misconceptions.message: Your instructions say to call 911 for these signs. They should not wait to see if they pass.

items.title: Heart failure clinic visit
items.original: Heart failure clinic visit in 7 days. Bring your weight log.
items.plain: Go to the heart failure clinic in 7 days. Bring the notebook where you wrote down your weight.

facts.statement: Clinic visit in 7 days; bring weight log.

items.title: Blood test (basic metabolic panel)
items.original: Get a blood test (basic metabolic panel) in 1 week to check your kidneys and potassium.
items.plain: Get a blood test in 1 week. It checks how your kidneys are working and your potassium level.

facts.statement: Blood test in 1 week for kidneys and potassium.
